channel.title: Azure on Sujith Quintelier
channel.description: Recent content in Azure on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: ECMP Nexthop
item.description:
Azure Virtual Network now supports ECMP routing in public preview. It lets customers use a single user-defined route to distribute traffic across 2 to 16 next hops.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Optimize agents from insights in Foundry Agent Service
item.description:
Optimization from insights is now in public preview in Foundry Agent Service. From an eligible prompt-agent trace in the Foundry portal, users can generate and evaluate candidate changes to an agent’s instructions and function-calling tool descriptions.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Native A2A passthrough for hosted agents in Foundry Agent Service
item.description:
Agent Service now supports native A2A passthrough for hosted agents in public preview, letting existing Agent2Agent agents connect without a protocol conversion layer. Incoming A2A requests are forwarded directly instead of being converted to the Responses protocol.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Cost controls for model and agent spending in Microsoft Foundry
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry now supports cost controls for model and agent spending in public preview. Users can set spending or token budgets for a Foundry resource or project, with alerts sent via Azure Event Grid or new requests blocked when the threshold is reached.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Central governance of hosted-agent outbound domains in Foundry Agent Service
item.description:
Azure Policy can now govern outbound destinations for hosted agents in Foundry Agent Service. Agent authors must attach a compliant egress policy before creating an agent version, and that policy controls outbound requests.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Enterprise Knowledge Graph in Foundry IQ
item.description:
Foundry IQ now supports Enterprise Knowledge Graph as a knowledge source in public preview. It extracts entities and relationships from unstructured content during indexing, using a user-provided ontology.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: IQ Retriever Zero in Foundry IQ
item.description:
Foundry IQ now supports IQ Retriever Zero in public preview. It uses an iterative retrieval approach to split complex questions into focused searches, review results, and search again within a configured budget before passing evidence to the answering model.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Files knowledge source for Foundry IQ
item.description:
Foundry IQ now supports a managed Files knowledge source in general availability. You can upload files directly for processing and indexing without setting up a storage account or scheduled indexer.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Deploy hosted agents from your own container registry in Foundry Toolkit for VS Code
item.description:
Foundry Toolkit for Visual Studio Code now supports deploying hosted agents from prebuilt images stored in customer-managed container registries, not just Azure Container Registry. Users select the corresponding registry connection in their Foundry project.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement: Azure AI Content Safety selected features will be retired on April 30, 2027
item.description:
Azure AI Content Safety will retire several preview capabilities on April 30, 2027. The retired items include Analyze Multimodal, custom categories (rapid) for text and image, and connected/disconnected containers for Text, Image, and Prompt Shields.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: WAF Insights for Azure Front Door
item.description:
WAF Insights is now generally available for Azure Front Door Web Application Firewall (WAF). It adds built-in dashboards in the WAF policy that combine logs and metrics for investigating blocked requests.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: ai: Hosted agents in your own virtual network: five checks when the Agents page times out
item.description:
The article explains five common checks for using hosted agents in a private virtual network, focusing on subnet selection, Agents page timeouts, TLS-inspecting firewalls, VNet peering and DNS, and why a subnet may remain in use after an account is deleted.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Governance policy guidance in Foundry Canvas and VS Code
item.description:
Governance policy guidance is now generally available in Foundry Canvas and the Foundry Toolkit for Visual Studio Code. As agents are built, both surfaces show relevant policies for agent types, models, toolboxes, and guardrails, including warnings.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Microsoft Copilot harness support in Foundry Toolkit for VS Code
item.description:
Agent Builder in Microsoft Foundry Toolkit for VS Code now supports prompt agents using the Microsoft Copilot harness in public preview. Developers can configure tools and skills, edit local YAML definitions, deploy changes to Foundry, and run the agents.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Announcing: The new Azure Databricks on Azure Government is now in Beta
item.description:
Azure Databricks is now available in Beta on Microsoft Azure Government. It provides the Databricks data and AI platform for U.S. public sector agencies and partners as a first-party Azure service.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: AI-powered application and database modernization with Modernize CLI
item.description:
Modernize CLI is in public preview for AI-assisted application and database modernization. It assesses application architecture, dependencies, cloud readiness, and the databases an application uses to guide modernization as a connected workflow.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: commandline: Introducing agent controls: An enterprise control plane for agent behavior
item.description:
Microsoft introduced agent controls, a managed Azure service for applying runtime policy to enterprise agents. It is built on the open-source Agent Control Specification (ACS) and Agent Hooks.

  • Source: Microsoft Command Line Blog

item.title: azure: Announcing: Azure Boost observability for NVMe disks
item.description:
Azure Boost observability for NVMe disks is an open-source CLI tool for compatible Azure VMs. It reports remote disk I/O and latency metrics and maps each in-VM disk to the corresponding disk.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Generally Available: Cobalt 200 Arm-based Dplsv7, Dpsv7, Epsv7, Mpsv4, and Lpsv5-series Virtual Machines
item.description:
Azure has made Cobalt 200 Arm-based VM series generally available across several SKUs, including Dpsv7/Dplsv7, Epsv7, Mpsv4, and Lpsv5. The update says these VMs improve on the previous Cobalt 100 generation.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Pod Sandboxing kata-vm-isolation-v2 runtime class
item.description:
Azure announced a public preview of the kata-vm-isolation-v2 runtime class for pod sandboxing. It is intended to improve isolated pod startup performance and reduce memory overhead compared with classic sandboxed pod flows that boot a new Kata VM per pod.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Pulic Preview: Azure Elastic SAN Next Generation
item.description:
Azure Elastic SAN Next Generation is now in public preview. It retains the existing Elastic SAN model, including a single SAN resource hierarchy for consolidating block storage workloads and dynamically sharing performance.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Limited Preview: Azure Workload Center for SAP and Azure Copilot Run SAP Agent
item.description:
Azure Workload Center for SAP is now available in limited preview, paired with Azure Copilot Run SAP Agent. The feature provides a workload-aware experience for operating SAP on Azure, powered by Workload Virtual Instance (WVI).

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Limited Preview: Azure Workload Center for Oracle and Azure Copilot Run Oracle Agent
item.description:
Azure Workload Center for Oracle and the Azure Copilot Run Oracle Agent are in preview as a workload-aware experience for operating Oracle workloads on Azure. The feature is powered by Workload Virtual Instance (WVI).

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In development] Private Preview: Azure DH/EHasv8 VMs based on 6th Gen AMD EPYC™ (“Venice”) processors
item.description:
Azure is previewing new DHasv8, DHalsv8, and EHasv8 virtual machine series powered by 6th Gen AMD EPYC (“Venice”) processors. The announcement says these VMs are aimed at next-generation cloud applications and provide expanded compute.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Confidential VMs with Intel TDX support on AKS
item.description:
AKS Confidential VM node pools now support Intel TDX in generally available state. This addresses the previous limitation where CVM node images only supported AMD SEV-SNP, preventing Intel TDX workloads from running on AKS.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Service tags for inbound rules in network security perimeter
item.description:
Azure announced public preview support for using service tags as inbound rules for third-party customers in network security perimeter. The feature is meant to simplify access management for network security perimeter-protected resources.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Perimeter link (cross perimeter) in network security perimeter
item.description:
Public preview adds perimeter links for secure cross-perimeter connectivity between resources protected by different network security perimeters, while preserving perimeter-based access controls.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Agent Grid helping secure AI agent communications
item.description:
Agent Grid is now in public preview for supported Azure environments. It adds identity-based Zero Trust network security so security teams can centrally govern communication between agents, models, tools, and external services.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Adaptive Virtual Patching
item.description:
Azure Adaptive Virtual Patching is in public preview. It uses an AI-orchestrated Adaptive Shield to reduce exposure to new, emerging, and newly disclosed zero-day vulnerabilities while customers test and deploy patches, starting with Linux workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: AI Security add-on for Azure Firewall Premium
item.description:
Azure Firewall Premium now has a public preview AI Security add-on. It adds five capabilities aimed at protecting AI applications, sensitive data, and malware/application defenses.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Agent Sandbox cluster extension
item.description:
Azure is introducing a public preview of an Agent Sandbox cluster extension for Kubernetes. It provides isolated environments for AI agent sessions that run untrusted, model-generated code, reducing the need for teams to build their own sandbox lifecycle and related operational logic.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Scale ExpressRoute Direct connectivity with link groups
item.description:
Azure ExpressRoute Direct now supports link groups in public preview. This lets high-throughput workloads scale connectivity by aggregating links, reducing the need to manage multiple independent ExpressRoute connections.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In development] Private Preview: Azure confidential VMs on 5th Gen AMD EPYC processors (DCasv7 and ECasv7 series)
item.description:
Azure has put its next-generation confidential VM series into private preview. The DCasv7, DCadsv7, DCalsv7, DCaldsv7, ECasv7, and ECadsv7 series run on 5th Gen AMD EPYC processors with AMD SEV-SNP to protect data in use.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In development] Private Preview: Project Nova
item.description:
Project Nova is a private preview for independent verification of specific claims without exposing underlying data. It is aimed at regulated industries that need to establish trust while keeping confidential information protected.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In development] Private Preview: Slack integration for Azure SRE Agent
item.description:
Azure SRE Agent will support Slack in private preview. Teams can mention the agent in Slack channels to start or continue incident investigations in the place where responders already coordinate.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Generally Available: Azure DDoS Protection custom policy
item.description:
Azure DDoS Protection custom policy is now generally available. It lets users override the default machine-learning auto-tuned detection thresholds for protected resources to better fit specific workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Advanced load balancing in Azure Application Gateway
item.description:
Advanced load balancing for Azure Application Gateway is now in public preview. It adds more control over traffic distribution across backends for different workload types, including AI applications and web traffic.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure App Service Builder
item.description:
Azure App Service Builder is in public preview. It provides a source-connected platform intended to simplify turning application code into a running cloud app by reducing the need to set up build pipelines, deployment workflows, and hosting infrastructure manually.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Application Gateway advanced routing rules
item.description:
Azure Application Gateway advanced routing rules is in public preview. It adds condition-based routing using HTTP request attributes, extending routing beyond traditional path- and host-based rules.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Artifact Validation for VM images
item.description:
Azure Artifact Validation is now in public preview. It lets VM image publishers and enterprise platform teams run Azure certification-grade quality and security checks on images within their own Azure subscriptions at any point in the build process.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Compute Spot plus
item.description:
Azure Compute Spot plus is now in public preview as an enhanced Azure Spot Virtual Machines tier. It is intended for interruption-tolerant workloads and offers greater runtime consistency plus earlier eviction signals.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure DDoS Protection peacetime telemetry
item.description:
Azure DDoS Protection peacetime telemetry is now in public preview. It lets customers view traffic to protected public IP addresses during normal operation, not just during active DDoS mitigation.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure DDoS Protection support for NAT Gateway v2 IP
item.description:
Azure DDoS Protection now supports the public IPs used by Azure NAT Gateway StandardV2 in public preview. This extends network-layer DDoS protection to IPv4 and IPv6 addresses carrying outbound internet traffic.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Network Watcher – Auto-create connection monitor
item.description:
Azure Network Watcher adds a public preview of auto-create connection monitor, which speeds up network monitoring setup across an Azure subscription. It replaces per-connection test creation with a subscription-wide creation flow.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Network Watcher – Connection analyzer
item.description:
Azure Network Watcher’s Connection analyzer for ExpressRoute Circuit is in public preview. It helps pinpoint where packet loss occurs between Azure and on-premises by providing faster, evidence-based troubleshooting.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Network Watcher – Resource health and topology in connection monitor tests
item.description:
Azure Network Watcher connection monitor tests now include resource health metrics and key performance metrics in the test topology, powered by Network Watcher topology. This extends the topology view beyond just the path between source and destination.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Bring-your-own image and Cosmos DB MCP server in Azure Connector Namespace hosted MCP​
item.description:
Azure Connector Namespace now offers a public preview of hosted MCP server capability, letting AI agents use tools without developers managing a separate hosting stack. The preview also adds support for bring-your-own image and a Cosmos DB MCP server.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Durable Task SDK for Go
item.description:
The Durable Task SDK for Go is now in public preview. It lets developers write orchestrations, activities, and durable entities in Go, with Durable Task Scheduler handling execution history and work dispatch.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Network Watcher Private Link support
item.description:
Azure Network Watcher VNet Flow Logs in preview now support flow log enrichment for Azure Private Link Service. This adds more visibility into traffic flowing through Private Link Service by retaining backend flow details.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Network Watcher rule recommendation
item.description:
Azure Network Watcher rule recommendation is in public preview. It uses Traffic Analytics insights to identify network traffic patterns and suggest security rule improvements.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Network Watcher VNet Flow Logs enriched with networkInterfaceIP field
item.description:
Azure Network Watcher VNet Flow Logs now include a new networkInterfaceIP field in public preview. The field records the IP address or addresses of the network interface where a flow was captured.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Pod snapshot cluster extension
item.description:
Azure has a public preview for a pod snapshot cluster extension that helps sandboxed workloads avoid losing in-memory state on restart. It is aimed at reducing reload and warmup costs for AI environments and other applications.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Sovereign Control Panel
item.description:
Sovereign Control Panel is in public preview in Azure. It provides an Azure portal experience for assessing and continuously monitoring sovereignty posture and reviewing evidence behind identified gaps.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: SQL Server 2025 support on Ubuntu 26.04 LTS
item.description:
SQL Server 2025 is now in public preview on Ubuntu 26.04 LTS. This lets users evaluate, test, and deploy SQL Server on Canonical’s latest long-term supported platform.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Virtual network integration in Logic Apps Automation
item.description:
Virtual network (VNet) integration is now in public preview for Azure Logic Apps Automation. This lets workflows and agents connect securely to resources inside Azure virtual networks.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: VM adaptive placement
item.description:
Azure VM adaptive placement is in public preview. It can improve VM deployment success when capacity is constrained by allowing Azure to place a VM on an available size instead of failing a create request for one exact size.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure AI Gateway
item.description:
Azure AI Gateway is now generally available as a fully managed Azure service. It connects users, applications, and agents to AI models and MCP tools across providers.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure API Management Premium v2
item.description:
Azure API Management Premium v2 is generally available in 35 Azure regions. The update expands deployment and scaling options for enterprise API workloads across more geographies.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Cache for Redis to Azure Managed Redis migration tooling
item.description:
Azure has generally available built-in DNS migration tooling for moving endpoints from Azure Cache for Redis Basic, Standard, and Premium tiers to Azure Managed Redis. It redirects the existing cache hostname to an Azure Managed Redis endpoint to simplify migration.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Connector Namespace
item.description:
Azure Connector Namespace is now generally available. It provides a fully managed integration service for connecting applications and AI agents to Microsoft, SaaS, and enterprise systems through prebuilt, reusable connectors.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Ebsv6 and Ebdsv6
item.description:
Azure Ebsv6 and Ebdsv6 virtual machines are now generally available. They use 5th Gen Intel Xeon processors and Azure Boost, targeting storage-intensive workloads with improved storage performance.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB is now generally available as a fully managed, cloud-native PostgreSQL service for high-performance, AI-driven, and large-scale workloads. It is positioned for use cases needing ultra-low latency, high scalability, and reliability.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure HorizonDB now available in 15 regions
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB is now generally available in 15 Azure regions. The expansion gives users more options to deploy PostgreSQL workloads closer to applications and users.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Infrastructure Resiliency Manager
item.description:
Azure Infrastructure Resiliency Manager is now generally available. It provides a unified, goal-driven way to improve application resiliency across Azure, including zonally resilient deployment templates and application assessment capabilities.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Multicloud Interconnect new cloud service provider support
item.description:
Azure Multicloud Interconnect is now generally available as a managed service for private connectivity between Azure and supported cloud providers. Google Cloud Platform support is in public preview, and Amazon Web Services support is included in the announcement text but truncated.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Red Hat OpenShift with hosted control planes
item.description:
Azure Red Hat OpenShift with hosted control planes is now generally available on Azure. This deployment option separates the OpenShift control plane from the worker nodes that run applications.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Discover Data Guardian from Sovereign Control Panel
item.description:
Data Guardian is now discoverable from the Sovereign Control Panel and is in Public Preview. It provides oversight for qualifying Microsoft engineer remote access to in-scope production systems in the EU data boundary.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Private endpoints for Azure Functions durable task scheduler
item.description:
Private endpoints for Azure Functions durable task scheduler are now generally available. This supports both Dedicated and Consumption SKU schedulers, allowing Azure Functions and other durable task SDK workloads to connect to the scheduler over a private IP address.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: User-assigned managed identity for Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
User-assigned managed identity (UMI) support is now generally available for Azure HorizonDB. It lets you assign and centrally manage Azure identities for HorizonDB clusters, reducing the need to manage credentials directly.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Zone-redundant Next-gen GP tier in Azure SQL Managed Instance
item.description:
Zone redundancy is now generally available for the Next-gen General Purpose tier in Azure SQL Managed Instance. It distributes critical service components across availability zones to improve resiliency and reduce the impact of zonal failures.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Announcing: Production Touch Ledger (PTL) Assessment Report
item.description:
The Production Touch Ledger (PTL) Assessment Report is now available. Capgemini independently validated PTL’s design for preserving completeness, tamper-evidence, and non-repudiation of production-access records.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Limited Preview: Compute templates for Azure
item.description:
Azure has introduced a limited preview of compute templates, which let customers define, version, and reuse standardized VM configurations across deployments. The feature is aimed at simplifying virtual machine configuration management.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Migrate PostgreSQL servers to Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure Database Migration Service now supports public preview migrations of supported PostgreSQL workloads to Azure HorizonDB. The migration experience is guided and available in the Azure portal.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Front Door adds native gRPC support
item.description:
Azure Front Door Standard and Premium now have public preview support for gRPC. The feature lets you route requests to specific services and methods and distribute traffic for gRPC applications through Front Door.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: WAF Insights for Azure Application Gateway
item.description:
WAF Insights for Azure Application Gateway Web Application Firewall is now generally available. The feature adds built-in dashboards in the WAF policy that combine logs and metrics for investigation.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Multi-disk crash-consistent VM restore points for Premium SSD v2 and Ultra Disks on VMs with SCSI disk controller
item.description:
Azure VM public preview adds multi-disk crash-consistent restore points for Premium SSD v2 and Ultra data disks on VMs using SCSI disk controllers. It supports agent-less capture of crash-consistent restore points.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: JWT validation for Application Gateway for Containers
item.description:
Application Gateway for Containers now supports centralized JWT validation in public preview through the AuthPolicy custom resource. It can validate token signature, issuer, lifetime, and configured audience using signing keys from a trusted HTTP source.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: MCP gateway for Application Gateway for Containers
item.description:
Application Gateway for Containers now supports Model Context Protocol (MCP) routing in preview via a new MCPRoute custom resource. This lets platform teams expose MCP servers behind a stable hostname and path while centralizing TLS and JWT validation through Web Application Firewall features.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Private ingress for Application Gateway for Containers
item.description:
Application Gateway for Containers now supports private frontends in public preview. These frontends are reachable only through approved Azure Private Link private endpoints, keeping internal, shared, and cross-cluster traffic on private networking.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: On-prem NAS share discovery and assessment are now available using Azure Migrate
item.description:
Azure Migrate added public preview support for discovering and assessing on-premises NAS shares. The feature helps plan migrations of Dell PowerScale (OneFS) and NetApp ONTAP storage to Azure.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement: Azure Fluid Relay
item.description:
Azure Fluid Relay will be retired on February 2, 2027. After that date, the service will be unavailable and workloads depending on it may be disrupted; the Fluid Framework remains available as open source.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Large OS Disk Encryption for Azure Confidential VM migrations
item.description:
Large OS Disk Encryption (LOSDE) is now generally available for Azure Confidential VM migration scenarios. It enables migration of larger production workloads with the OS disk fully protected.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure MCP Server 3.0
item.description:
Azure MCP Server 3.0 is now generally available. The release expands Azure integration for AI agents and developer tools via the open Model Context Protocol (MCP), including new infrastructure-as-code support through Azure Terraform.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Marketplace private offer enhancements
item.description:
Microsoft Marketplace private offers now include enhancements for eligible offers, with simplified handling of pricing and terms aligned to organizational needs. The note highlights flexible billing and custom contract lengths.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Network Watcher VNet flow logs filtering
item.description:
Azure Network Watcher VNet flow logs filtering is now generally available. It lets you limit logged network traffic using criteria such as IP addresses, ports, protocols, encryption state, flow state, and traffic direction.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: visualstudio: Are You Getting Everything You Can from Your Visual Studio Subscription?
item.description:
The post reminds Visual Studio subscribers that their subscription may already include benefits they can use to try Azure services, access certification learning resources, and reuse UI/dashboard components. It is framed as a prompt to explore subscription perks they may be overlooking.

  • Source: Visual Studio Blog

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Disable VNet peering route
item.description:
Azure announced public preview of Disable VNet Peering Route (DPR), a route-table capability that suppresses system-generated peering routes on subnets associated with the route table. This gives more control over traffic flow between peered virtual networks.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Advanced platform metrics for Azure Monitor
item.description:
Advanced platform metrics for Azure Monitor are now generally available. The release adds finer-grained signals to help customers identify changes and trends in resources more quickly and accurately.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: External key management for Azure Key Vault Managed HSM
item.description:
External key management for Azure Key Vault Managed HSM is now generally available in all Azure public regions. It allows organizations with regulatory or sovereignty requirements to keep physical control of key-encryption keys while using Azure services that support this capability.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Standard service endpoint
item.description:
Azure introduced Standard service endpoint as a generally available capability in the Azure Private Link family. It is designed to provide a scalable, secure way to connect Azure IaaS workloads to Azure PaaS services, addressing manageability and scale limitations.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Availabile: Automatic zone balance for Virtual Machine Scale Sets
item.description:
Automatic zone balance for Virtual Machine Scale Sets is generally available. It continuously monitors scale sets across availability zones and redistributes VM instances when zonal imbalances are detected.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement: Azure Key Vault Secrets Provider Extension for Azure Arc enabled Kubernetes clusters
item.description:
Azure Key Vault Secrets Provider Extension for Azure Arc-enabled Kubernetes will be retired on October 9, 2027. Users should migrate to the Azure Key Vault Secret Store Extension before that date.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server in East US 3
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server is now generally available in the East US 3 Azure region. The update announces regional deployment availability.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement: Microsoft Dev Box will be retired on September 18, 2028
item.description:
Microsoft Dev Box will be retired on September 18, 2028. The closing-down process begins on September 14, 2026, after which the service will eventually be unavailable.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement: Azure Deployment Environments will be retired on February 22, 2027
item.description:
Azure Deployment Environments will retire on February 22, 2027. The closing-down process begins on September 14, 2026, after which the service will no longer be available.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Exceptions in WAF for Azure Application Gateway and Azure Front Door
item.description:
Azure Web Application Firewall exceptions are now generally available for Azure Application Gateway and Azure Front Door. The feature lets customers exclude specific parts of a request from WAF inspection to reduce false positives.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Anyscale on Azure
item.description:
Anyscale on Azure is now generally available. It is a managed platform for running distributed Python workloads on Ray, deployed directly on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and integrated with Azure services.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: AKS on bare metal now on Ubuntu
item.description:
Azure has a public preview for running AKS on bare metal using Ubuntu, aimed at on-premises Kubernetes deployments without a virtualization layer. The update highlights support for local control of hardware and software, with a focus on AI workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: visualstudio: What Would You Build in Azure If You Didn’t Have to Ask for a Budget First?
item.description:
The post says eligible Visual Studio subscribers may already have access to a personal Azure sandbox, making it easier to try .NET apps, serverless, containers, proofs of concept, or unfamiliar Azure services without requesting a budget first.

  • Source: Visual Studio Blog

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure HorizonDB expands to additional regions
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB is now available in additional Azure regions in public preview. The expansion gives users more deployment options for PostgreSQL workloads closer to applications and users.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: IPv6 Support for Application Gateway WAF
item.description:
Azure Application Gateway WAF now supports inspection and enforcement for IPv6 traffic in Public Preview. This adds IPv6 support to the web application firewall layer.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: commandline: Azure Content Understanding: Building on lessons from a decade of Document Intelligence
item.description:
Microsoft reflects on a decade of document understanding work and how those lessons inform Azure Content Understanding. The piece emphasizes limits of LLMs in document reading and the importance of handling edge cases with confidence, grounding, and reasoning.

  • Source: Microsoft Command Line Blog

item.title: azure: Retirement: DCsv3 and DCdsv3-series Azure Virtual Machines will be retired on October 31, 2029
item.description:
DCsv3 and DCdsv3-series Azure Linux, Windows, and Dedicated Host virtual machines will be retired on October 31, 2029. After that date, they will no longer be available for use or purchase, so workloads should be migrated before then.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: SQL performance monitoring for SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines
item.description:
Microsoft has released a public preview of Microsoft-managed performance monitoring for SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines. It lets you monitor SQL Server on Azure VMs without creating custom collection scripts or manually correlating telemetry.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement: NVv3-series Azure Virtual Machines
item.description:
Microsoft Azure retired several NVv3-series virtual machine sizes on September 30, 2026. Any remaining NVv3-series VMs are also being retired.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement: NVv4-series Azure Virtual Machines
item.description:
Azure retired the NVv4-series VM sizes listed in the update, effective September 30, 2026. The retirement includes Standard_NV4as_v4 through Standard_NV32ahs_v4 variants.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Ubuntu 26.04 support in AKS
item.description:
AKS now has public preview support for Ubuntu 26.04 node pools through a new Ubuntu2604 OS SKU based on Ubuntu Minimal. The update is intended to help teams move with Ubuntu LTS releases while addressing package footprint, security, and compatibility concerns.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Announcing: Azure canvases for GitHub Copilot
item.description:
Azure canvases for GitHub Copilot are interactive shared workspaces that surface Azure tools, dashboards, and guided workflows alongside Copilot conversations. The update highlights using them to explore Azure resources, analyze costs, and build hosted skills.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement: Dv3, Dsv3, Ev3, and Esv3 Azure VMs
item.description:
Microsoft announced retirement of the Dv3, Dsv3, Ev3, and Esv3 Azure VM series in public cloud regions. These VM families will reach end-of-life on November 15, 2029.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Storage optimized Lasv5 and Laosv5 Azure VM series
item.description:
Azure has generally available Lasv5 and Laosv5 storage optimized VM series, based on 5th Gen AMD EPYC (Turin). The series offers 2–160 vCPUs, 8 GiB memory per vCPU, and 720 GB of local NVMe disk per vCPU.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Automatic Zone Placement for Virtual Machine Scale Sets
item.description:
Azure has introduced a public preview of Automatic Zone Placement for Virtual Machine Scale Sets. Azure will automatically choose suitable availability zones based on SKU availability, capacity, and placement requirements, reducing the need to manage zone lists manually.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Ultra Disk
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server now supports Ultra Disk in public preview. It is intended for I/O-intensive, transaction-heavy workloads that need consistently low latency.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: SQL Server on Azure Local Disconnected (ALDO)
item.description:
Azure Local Disconnected (ALDO) for SQL Server is now generally available. It extends SQL Server support to disconnected environments that cannot maintain continuous Azure connectivity, including regulated, secure, remote, and air-gapped deployments.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: SQL Formatter
item.description:
SQL Formatter is now generally available for Visual Studio Code, allowing SQL scripts to be formatted directly in the editor. It includes customizable formatting options to match preferred code styles.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: SQL Migration Agent Skills for assessment, migration, and validation
item.description:
SQL Migration Agent Skills are now generally available to help automate SQL Server to Azure migrations. They provide reusable AI-powered skills for assessment, target selection, migration execution, and post-migration validation.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement: Microsoft HPC Pack
item.description:
Microsoft is retiring all versions of HPC Pack. It is entering a one-year retirement period with limited retirement-only support, and end of support is August 27, 2027.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure SQL Dev Hub
item.description:
Azure SQL Dev Hub is in public preview as a central starting point for building applications with Azure SQL. It provides guidance for connecting from .NET, Python, Node.js, and Java, and supports development workflows including AI agents.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Luxembourg - Azure Extended Zones
item.description:
Microsoft announced general availability of the Luxembourg Azure Extended Zone. Azure Extended Zones are small-footprint Azure extensions designed for low-latency workloads and data residency requirements in specific metro areas or jurisdictions.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: security: Storm-3168: Agentic-driven cloud attacks using compromised service principals
item.description:
Microsoft describes Azure attacks linked to Storm-3168 using compromised service principals, including reconnaissance, resource deletion, and credential access. The post links the activity to JADEPUFFER and includes defender guidance.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: azure: Retirement: Azure Communication Services (ACS) standalone services will be retired on September 30, 2028
item.description:
Microsoft will retire several standalone Azure Communication Services offerings on September 30, 2028. After that date, the affected services will no longer be available.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Instant Access for VM restore points
item.description:
Instant Access for application-consistent restore points on Azure virtual machines is now generally available. It lets you start restoring a disk from a restore point before the underlying snapshot copy completes, for VMs using Premium SSD v2 or Ultra disks as data disks.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Flex Nodes for AKS
item.description:
Flex Nodes for AKS is now in public preview. It lets application and platform teams use hybrid and edge infrastructure as connected worker nodes to an AKS control plane in Azure, while keeping a consistent Kubernetes control plane.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Introducing a Guided Copilot Experience for Building Azure Apps in VS Code
item.description:
Microsoft is previewing a guided Copilot experience in VS Code for building Azure apps. It provides a structured workflow that helps move from idea to deployed app instead of relying on a free-form chat session.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Functions support for PowerShell 7.6
item.description:
Azure Functions now generally supports PowerShell 7.6. Apps can be developed locally with PowerShell 7.6 and deployed to Azure Functions plans.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Foundry Routines in Foundry Agent Service
item.description:
Foundry Agent Service now includes Foundry Routines in public preview. This adds a native trigger primitive so published agents can run automatically on schedules or in response to business events.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Mdsv4 and Msv4 Series Virtual Machines for SAP
item.description:
Azure announced public preview availability of the Mdsv4 and Msv4 memory-optimized virtual machine series for SAP. The series uses 6th Generation Intel Xeon Scalable processors and includes advanced security features plus Azure Boost technologies.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Payments HSM v2
item.description:
Azure Payments HSM v2 is in public preview. It is a highly available, single-tenant payment HSM service for payment processing, credential issuance, PIN processing, key management, and authentication data protection, with exclusive administrative control retained by the customer.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement Update: SAP container images removed October 14, 2026
item.description:
SAP container images are scheduled for removal on October 14, 2026. The containerized SAP data connector retired on September 14, 2026 and is now unsupported and unmaintained, though existing TLS-compliant agents can still send logs through the retired HTTP Data Collector API.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Red Hat OpenShift with hosted control planes
item.description:
Azure Red Hat OpenShift with hosted control planes is now in public preview. This deployment option separates the OpenShift control plane into a fully managed service from the worker nodes that run customer workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Copilot Troubleshooting Agent
item.description:
Azure Copilot Troubleshooting Agent is now generally available. It provides a built-in Azure Copilot capability for investigating and resolving operational issues, and is available through Azure Copilot and Support.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Ephemeral OS Disk with full caching for VM/VMSS
item.description:
Azure Ephemeral OS Disk with full caching is now generally available for new virtual machines and Virtual Machine Scale Sets. It caches the full OS image on local VM storage so reads no longer go to remote storage after caching completes.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Developer CLI (azd) Extension Framework
item.description:
The Azure Developer CLI (azd) Extension Framework is now generally available. It lets developers, teams, and partners extend azd with custom capabilities for their application development workflows.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Virtual Network Manager IPAM in additional Azure regions
item.description:
Azure Virtual Network Manager IP address management is now generally available in additional regions: US Gov Virginia, US Gov Texas, US Gov Arizona, China North 3, and China East 3.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Multicloud Interconnect
item.description:
Azure Multicloud Interconnect is now in public preview. It provides managed private connectivity between Azure and supported cloud providers, with AWS as the first provider available in preview.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure VM Image Builder in sovereign and air-gapped clouds
item.description:
Azure VM Image Builder is now generally available in Azure Government, China North 3, Azure Government Secret, and Azure Government Top Secret. The service can be used across these sovereign and air-gapped environments with the same managed image-building experience.

  • Source: Azure Updates
